While this product does the job it does so with difficulty! The original filter stood up firmly during it's serviceable life fine. I replaced it with the first of these. Initially, the filter had a little trouble standing up in the humidifier, after a while it was fine. Then time for the second filter. Much harder to stand up even a little bit, it collapsed into the center on itself. Very, very flimsy!!!

I fixed the problem by cutting the bottom portion of a plastic juice container, just happens to be right size. I place the container inside the filter and it remains erect and the device is fully functionable!

**EDIT** June 6, I've only had these for about a month and one of the rubber seals around the top of one of the k-cups has fallen off and got lost down the drain. I do not wash these in the dishwasher, I wash them by hand. I did not notice that this fell off and went to use it and it wouldn't close and that is when I noticed the seal was missing. Is it possible to get replacement seals?"
**EDIT** July 7, Somehow, I managed to chip one of my k-cups. I'm not sure how I did it since I'm careful and handwash them.
